Exercise A

Read & Spot

Read the review and choose the correct form for each gap.

Before you read

This question is not marked - just write what comes to mind.

A Review of Nonna's Kitchen

How it works: an adjective describes a noun — "a delicious meal". An adverb describes a verb — "the waiter worked quickly". After verbs like be, look, smell, taste use the adjective: "The soup smells good."

1 Last night I had a really meal at Nonna's Kitchen.

2 The waiters worked all evening.

3 The dining room looked with its candles and flowers.

4 My brother once cooked pasta at home, and it tasted .

5 The staff were so that we left a big tip.

6 We left the restaurant and promised to come back.

Exercise C

Comparing Things

Short adjectives take -er/-est, long ones take more/most — and three are irregular.

Task

1 My bike is than yours.

2 This is the film I have ever seen.

3 She sings than her sister.

4 This exercise is than the last one.

5 He drives of all my friends.

6 Today is the day of the year — rain, cold, homework!

Exercise D

Writing

Describe your favourite place.

Task

Write a short text (6-8 sentences) about your favourite place for a class photo wall. Describe the place with at least three adjectives and say what people do there with at least three adverbs. Include one comparison (better than, the most ...).
